claim_scope: CPU static implementation and unit evidence for a causal coefficient prior and prior-centered convex online solve. No trained adapter, accuracy, validation, test_id, or promotion claim.
hypothesis: A zero-initialized causal hypernetwork can predict a mean, diagonal precision, and trust fraction for fixed physical-head coefficients, while a prior-centered convex ridge solve can resolve online-design null directions without reading future truth and retain exact parent rollback whenever the online data objective worsens beyond tolerance.
expected_mechanism: Offline train truth teaches a coefficient prior over the oracle-qualified physical-head span. At deployment, two onset frames and DG features update that prior through a closed-form posterior solve rather than attempting to identify all coefficients from two frames alone.
unit_gates: zero-initialized prior mean is exactly zero
all predicted precisions and trust fractions remain within registered bounds
zero precision reproduces the uncentered ridge solution
a learned prior resolves a coefficient direction in the online-design nullspace
trust projection enforces the registered correction cap
online data-objective regression triggers bit-exact parent rollback
the deployment API accepts no future target tensor

allowed: DG features derived from the frozen parent and public inputs

solver_contract.trust_projection: Euclidean correction norm relative to frozen parent norm
solver_contract.acceptance: finite posterior improvement plus online data objective no worse than frozen tolerance

rollback: The active parent training process remains paused in memory and its model/trainer/state schemas are unchanged. Remove no checkpoint; if any unit gate fails, reject this isolated adapter core and resume parent training unchanged.
